bestBets.overview: At the time of writing (Tuesday) the track is rated a good 4 and with fine weather forecast it should remain in that condition. VIDEO VIXEN found form quickly last time in and any positive market moves must be respected. LUMINOUS GIRL was just even at Ipswich last time but had been game in the placings prior and has since won a home track trial. TEXAS COWGIRL was specked at healthy odds when tailing them in on debut but this is as easier maiden. Long-time maiden DEMES GIRL has tuned up for this with a trial placing and she has been in the minors when new.

raceTips.comment: LUMINOUS GIRL hasn’t been far away in recent runs and looks nearing a win. With a month since her latest run she’s been given a trial to keep her up to the mark and she’s well suited at the 800m. VIDEO VIXEN resumes for the new stable.  She gets a tongue tie and a set of winkers on for the first time and the low draw should see her afforded every chance. TEXAS COWGIRL was well beaten on debut at Eagle Farm but a post race vet exam found her to be shinsore. She showed talent in her two trials and if she’s 100%, she’ll be right in this. GENERAL DANCER resumes for the new stable. She’s been readied for this with two solid trials and get blinkers and a tongue tie on.

bestBets.overview: CHAT MIGNON was unwanted in betting when leading and bolting in on debut. She'll only be improved and must be taken seriously this time despite the rise in grade and wide draw. EVER SO READY has performed well at both fresh runs and has tuned up for this with a pair of trial wins. RUNAROUND SUE has been game in defeat at both runs back from a break and strips all the fitter for them. Respect any positive market moves on speedy former NSW gelding AETERNUM at his local debut.

raceTips.comment: EVER SO READY returns as a gelding. A winner on debut, he’s shown talent and he looks ready to fire off two pleasing trial wins. RUNAROUND SUE has been the runner up in both starts this preparation and looks well placed with the slight drop back in grade. She gets in well with the claim and will be strong late. CHAT MIGNON kicked off her career with a dominant 3.7 length victory over 800m at Kilcoy. She’ll be better for the experience but does have to overcome the wide draw as she steps up in grade. I AM GONE saluted at Gatton two starts back and was solid last start at Ipswich off a wide run. With gate 2 and the 4kg claim, she’ll be right in this.

bestBets.overview: ELNAJEEB was no match for the victor fresh before just being outgunned second up. He should be peaking now and can fight out the finish again. ZOUBUCA SHOTS battled away soundly after leading fresh and should be in this for a long way as well. CITY BOUND failed to finish off at Ipswich but had placed at two of her first three runs this prep and this is an easier maiden. The rest of the field look to have minor claims only with MISHANI SENORITA perhaps the best of those.

raceTips.comment: ELNAJEEB has been placed in both of his runs this time in and it was a solid effort last start as he had to work hard early to cross from a wide gate. He gets in well with the 4kg claim and will be strong late. ZOUBUCA SHOTS took up the running and was just collated late when resuming over 1200m at Murwillumbah. She strips fitter second up and will take catching. CITY BOUND finished off strongly to claim third at the Sunshine Coast two runs back but felt the pinch late last time after being caught wide. She’s fit, she’s shown ability in her trials and can certainly figure. DIVINELLE comes off a solid effort to finish second at Dalby. The rise to 1200m looks ideal and she draws to get the right run.

bestBets.overview: LARUSSO didn't have much luck from a wide gate fresh before working home soundly to place when staying at 1350m second up. He'll be further improved and the rise to 1500m suits nicely. His stablemate LUCONI just missed when specked at healthy odds fresh before finding a couple better as fave second up. SO YOU CAN TORQUE has found the line nicely at both runs back from a break and is proved at this longer trip. STANDLEE finished off hard for a deserved win at Beaudesert and is nicely in at the weights after the claim.

raceTips.comment: STANDLEE proved too good last start over 1400m at Beaudesert and will appreciate stepping out over that bit further. He’s ultra-consistent and whilst he does rise in grade, he gets right down in the weights. LUCONI has been placed in both runs this time in and presents at peak fitness. Beaten only a neck when resuming, then he was strong through the line last time at the mile. 1500m will suit and he’ll be there at the finish. LARUSSO covered plenty of ground first up here but found the line well last time at Ipswich. He strips fitter and will be suited with the rise in trip. HEAVENLY LOVE won well when resuming over 1350m here and produced a solid effort last time to place at Toowoomba. The rise in journey suits but he does have the wide draw to contend with.

bestBets.overview: ICYMISS scored a dominant maiden win at Rocky fresh before disappointing at the Gold Coat second up. She was again good when placing at the Sunny Coast last time and this isn't any tougher. She can go one better. Former NSW gelding OUR WARRIOR has placed at three of five previous fresh runs. Check for confidence in betting at his local debut. ZARIPPA scraped home over this route and was again sound after leading at Dalby. WORLDY SPIRIT has been game in the placings at both runs this term and strips all the fitter for them.

raceTips.comment: ICYMISS closed off strongly into second last start over 1000m at the Gold Coast and looks ideally placed here with the slight rise in distance. She’s draw well and will be strong late. FLITGROVE won well over this trip at Gatton two runs back but was only plain last start at Ipswich. Given a seven week let-up, the blinkers go back on and she draws to get the gun run. ZARIPPA is hard fit and racing well. He got the job done over this track and trip two runs back and was just collared late last time over 1200m. Back to 1100m suits and he gets in nicely with the claim. OUR WARRIOR resumes for the new stable and has placed in three of five first up appearances.

bestBets.overview: HEART 'N' POWER ran a much improved race at huge odds on debut for this yard, then led and gave a good sight last time. She can again hold the front from the kind draw and be in this for a long way as well. FIERY LASS finished off hard for a deserved maiden win third up, then tired after facing the breeze last time. She can bounce back with a quieter ride. YES TO EXCESS is proved when new, draws kindly and has tuned up for this with a Beaudesert trial placing. RARE MOON found the line well at Ipswich last start and makes each-way appeal on that performance.

raceTips.comment: HEART ‘N’ POWER wasn’t far away in much stronger company at Ipswich two starts back and was just run down late there last time after leading. Taylor Marshall stays aboard and will afford her every chance from the low draw. FIERY LASS let down strongly to score two runs back but wasn’t suited last time when racing up on speed. She’s hard fit and can bounce back. YES TO EXCESS resumes for the new stable. She has won first up previously and with the blinkers on and inside draw, there’s a bit to like about her. WORDLY SPIRIT hasn’t been far away in two runs back this campaign and looks ready to peak. She rise in trip should suit and the 2kg claim is a big plus.

bestBets.overview: ED I AM was specked at juicy odds and closed well to place at Ipswich fresh. He'll only be improved and this isn't any tougher. WATER LAD was dominant at Dalby three starts ago and has been narrowly denied at both subsequent runs. CONEY ISLAND BABY was a tad disappointing at the short quote last time but has been freshened up for this and he'd been holding form well prior. SHINING PROISIR has been game in the placings at both runs this term and strips all the fitter for them.

raceTips.comment: LYRICAL GANGSTER comes off a strong all-the-way win over 1300m at Toowoomba. He steps up from maiden grade but lightly raced, he looks to have upside. He’ll just need luck from the wide gate. SHINING POISIR has been placed at his past two starts and looks ready to peak third up. He did want to lay in last time, so the bubble cheeker goes on. CONEY ISLAND BABY returns from the let-up. Back in grade and in trip, he can improve. WATER LAD has found form since joining the Moore stable. Hard fit, he’s proven at this journey and draws to get the right run.
